title: Crochet Lotus Flower
name: Lotus Flower
seoTitle: Crochet Lotus Flower Pattern, Layered (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet lotus flower pattern: green leaves, two layers of pink petals worked in front loops and a yellow seed centre. Printable PDF, step by step.
lead: A layered lotus that sits flat: a green base with six leaves, then two rings of pink petals worked into the front loops, and a little yellow centre.
yarn: Cotton yarn in green, pink, light pink and yellow

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in green, pink, light pink and yellow

notes: Rounds 2 and 3 of the base use the back loops only. That leaves the front loops free for the petals.
Picot: ch 1, then sl st into the top of the stitch you just made.

rounds.text: 6 sc in a magic ring, sl st, ch 1.
inc in the back loop of each st (BLO), sl st, ch 1.
(sc, inc) x6 in back loops, sl st.
(ch 2, [dc, tr, ch 1 picot] in next st, [tr, dc] in next st, ch 2, sl st in next st) x6. Fasten off.

sections.title: Part 2: Outer petals
sections.note: Work into the free front loops of round 2.

rounds.text: Join pink. (ch 2, [dc, tr, ch 1 picot, dc] in next st, ch 2, sl st in next st) x6. Fasten off.

sections.title: Part 3: Inner petals
sections.note: Work into the free front loops of round 1.

rounds.text: Join light pink. (ch 2, dc, ch 1 picot, dc in the same st, ch 2, sl st in next st) x6. sl st, ch 1 and cut the yarn.
6 sc in a magic ring, sl st, ch 1.
6 sc, sl st, ch 2 and cut the yarn.

finishing: Sew the yellow centre in the middle of the flower.
Weave in all the ends on the back.
